text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This research paper focuses explicitly on downscaling global land-use scenario data to the national level, using Belgium as a case study, thus providing a national-scale spatial implementation. The primary objective is LULC prediction/simulation, demonstrated by downscaling LUH2 global land use projections into higher-resolution land use maps at 100 m and 10 m spatial resolutions. The study implements three future scenarios (Sustainability SSP1xRCP2.6, Regional Rivalry SSP3xRCP6.0, Fossil-fuelled Development SSP5xRCP8.5) with quantitative comparisons. It uses spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., RSR, overall accuracy, Kappa) to validate the downscaled maps. The outputs include mapped LULC projections at fine spatial resolution. The scale is national (Belgium), and the study provides quantitative and spatially explicit future LULC predictions under multiple scenarios. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
